title: Carrot early callus transcriptome reproducibility code and derived data
description: Retains the original primary analysis and adds final augmented homology-supported annotation and fixed-prior PyDESeq2 coefficient sensitivity with complete source provenance. No new biological experiment, primary FDR or gene-set reselection.
notes: The manuscript authors, in order, are Tae-Yoon Kim, Taejin Kim and Seung-Yop Lee; Seung-Yop Lee is the corresponding author. Manuscript authorship is distinct from archived-resource attribution. Tae-Yoon Kim is the creator of the archived analysis resource. Taejin Kim contributed Methodology (DataCite Other). Seung-Yop Lee contributed Conceptualization, Writing – review & editing, and Supervision (DataCite Supervisor).
